text: Experience is the name everyone gives to their mistakes.
author: Oscar Wilde
visual_brief: An industrial design sketch of an overloaded mechanical linkage that has been repeatedly welded, braced, and re-drilled after failure, rendered with confident perspective linework and callout arrows pointing to successive reinforcement plates. Dashed phantom lines outline the original, pristine component before the accumulated structural bends and patches.
alt: Technical sketch of a heavily patched and bent mechanical component
